subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Does the sandbox owner approve Podman as a bundled, opt-in local-container backend after accepting its connection-validation, rootless-user, browser-exclusion, and Codex network-policy security contract?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive and a maintainer has already endorsed the core ownership boundary, but accepting a second local container engine changes the supported isolation boundary and cannot be resolved by a mechanical contributor edit alone.

options.title: Approve the bundled Podman boundary
options.body: Accept the documented local-or-Podman-Machine target restriction and merge after the owner confirms the engine-specific security model is supported.

options.title: Request a narrower security contract
options.body: Keep the PR open and require a specific restriction or additional proof if the accepted Podman connection or rootless behavior should be narrower.

options.title: Defer the backend
options.body: Pause the feature if OpenClaw does not want to support a second local container engine in the current sandbox boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the bundled Podman boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the documented local-or-Podman-Machine target restriction and merge after the owner confirms the engine-specific security model is supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The current refactor, assignment, and recorded bundled-core recommendation place this decision closest to the sandbox-area owner path.
